\begin{enumerate}[resume]
\item An airplane flies horizontally from east to west at 320 mi/hr relative
to the air. If it flies in a steady 40-mi/hr wind that blows horizontally
toward the southwest ($45^{\circ}$ south of west), find the speed
and direction of the airplane relative to the air.\vfill
\item Which has a greater horizontal component, a 100-N force directed at
an angle of $60^{\circ}$ above the horizontal or a 60-N force directed
at an angle of $30^{\circ}$ above the horizontal?\vfill
\item In still air, a parachute with payload would fall vertically at a
terminal speed of 40 m/s. Find the direction and magnitude of its
terminal velocity relative to the ground if it falls in a steady wind
blowing horizontally from west to east at 10 m/s.\vfill 
\item A woman in a kayak paddles due west at 4 mi/hr relative to the water
in a current that flows northwest at 2 mi/hr. Find the speed and direction
of the canoe relative to the shore.\vfill
\item If a 500-lb load is suspended from the ceiling by two chains such
that the angle between each chain and the ceiling is $45^{\circ}$,
what is the magnitude of the force each chain must be able to withstand?\vfill
\end{enumerate}
